articleTitle: How to Split Group Travel Costs Fairly When You're the Single Friend
imageHeadline: Why Singles Shouldn't Pay More on Group Trips
imageSubtext: Equal splits aren't always fair—here's how to talk about it
pinTitle: How to Split Group Travel Costs Fairly When You're the Single Friend | Fair Cost Splitting
pinDescription: Paying the same as couples for shared accommodations can mean you're actually paying more per person. Learn why equal splits aren't always equitable and get practical language for proposing a fairer method that preserves friendships and respects everyone's budget.
